disposition.target: DB story of each service writing a decision record (rwb-decision and the 19 services)
disposition.change: Name the local decision-record table and its DDL, created through the decision-record library, with the target field list and the case and trace ID held in inputsRef.

State that each service chains its records in chain_seq order, the ledger chains entries on ingest, the daily WORM fingerprint covers the ledger chain, and the ledger is the chain of record with the local chain for replay.

disposition.target: AsyncAPI document for rwb.decision-record.v1 (shared-topic contract review)
disposition.change: Publish the DecisionRecorded payload and the ingest rule: CloudEvents id as dedupe key in processed_event, per-case order, chain_seq and prev_hash assigned by rwb-decision under the chain lock, catch-up within five minutes.
